item.tib: mdo kun las btus pa chen po zhes bya ba
item.skt: ma hA sU tra sa muts+tsha ya nA ma
item.coloph: dge bsnyen rdo rje g.yung drung dang / bslab gus yid gzhungs gzhon nu shes rab dang / bzod ldan rin chen bzang po yongs la drin/ gdung brgyud sa las 'phags pa pa tshab ldang gi sras/ bslab gsum sgrub pas skyong bar 'jig rten rab grags pa/ da ltar lnga brgya'i dus kyi bstan pa'i srog 'dzin pa'i/ dge slong yon tan grags kyi rab tu bskul gyur pas/ kha che'i bram ze mkhas pa rgyal ba kun dga' dang / sgra bsgyur phul du phyin pa pa tshab khu gsum kyis/ ya rabs spyod pa ma nyams pa tshab rom po'i khul/ gnod sbyin nor spel grags pa zhogs lha phyug po'i 'dabs/ mkhas btsun bzhugs rjes skyod pa ya gad gtsug lag tu/ mdo sde kun las btus pa bsgyur cing legs par zhus/ bod 'bangs yongs la sman pas sa yang rab tu g.yos/ dge legs bsam pa dag pas dgongs pa mthar yang chub
